mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved by 7.4 percentage points from t-2w to t-0w (from -72.0 to -64.6), signaling a consistent upward trend. This momentum will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further above the baseline.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 7.4 points over three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has stabilized near +17-20 percent above baseline across all four weeks, indicating sustained lockdown compliance. This constraint on out-of-home activity will suppress RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks relative to the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stable at +17.4 to +20.0 across all weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL drops below +10 percent while RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises more than 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has recovered from -64.3 (t-2w) to -59.1 (t-0w), a 5.2-point gain. When transit recovery exceeds 4 points week-on-week, commuting infrastructure capacity increases, enabling retail foot traffic to rise over the subsequent four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 4 percentage points from t-2w to t-0w
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 5.2 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls below -62 percent in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed -60 percent by week 4.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has improved from -39.4 (t-2w) to -31.4 (t-0w), indicating relaxed restrictions on essential retail. This signals policy easing that will extend to non-essential retail, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises more than 6 percentage points from t-2w to t-0w
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 8 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -35 percent in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not improve by at least 3 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains severely depressed at -58.7 percent (t-0w), indicating outdoor recreation is still restricted. When PARKS and RETAIL_REC are both suppressed, outdoor substitution effects are absent, preventing retail recovery. RETAIL_REC will remain depressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -55 percent and RETAIL_REC below -60 percent simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -58.7 and RETAIL_REC at -64.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -50 percent while RETAIL_REC simultaneously improves by more than 8 percentage points in the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has stabilized at -53.1 percent (t-0w), showing no further deterioration. When workplace mobility stabilizes above -55 percent, it signals sufficient commuting activity to support retail foot traffic, enabling RETAIL_REC to improve over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES remains above -55 percent for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stable at -53.1 to -54.6 over last two weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES falls below -56 percent in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not improve by at least 2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both recovering (TRANSIT +5.2 points, WORKPLACES +1.5 points from t-2w to t-0w). When both commuting infrastructure and workplace activity improve simultaneously, the combined effect amplifies retail foot traffic over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve by at least 3 points from t-2w to t-0w
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT +5.2 and WORKPLACES +1.5 from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: Either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES falls by more than 3 percentage points in the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed -60 percent by week 4.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-February marks the approach of spring in Lombardy. PARKS mobility remains severely depressed at -58.7 percent, but as seasonal warming occurs over the next four weeks, outdoor activity will increase, substituting away from indoor retail. RETAIL_REC will decline further.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -55 percent at t-0w and seasonal transition begins
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -58.7 percent at t-0w in mid-February
failure_condition: PARKS does not improve by at least 10 percentage points over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC improves by more than 5 percentage points despite PARKS remaining depressed.
